method: follow-up comparison of means, no regression
layout: overall, treatment and control means in columns
tags.picture_matters: The text layer reads this table correctly; the picture matters for one check only: the last row prints a difference of 1.127 although its means (8.692 - 9.819) give -1.127.

context_needed: COMSIP economic-empowerment pilot for Social Cash Transfer Programme households in Malawi. Cluster RCT: 6 treatment clusters drawn at random from 20 clusters in Mwanza district and split 2-2-2 across lump-sum plus training, lump-sum only and training-only; the control group is the other 14 Mwanza clusters plus 10 clusters drawn at random from neighbouring Neno district (pp. 22-23). Table A4 pools the three arms ('6 pilot clusters') against all 24 control clusters at the 2017 follow-up. The paper's impact estimates for the same outcomes are regressions with baseline controls and clustered SEs, overall and by arm, in Tables 5-18 (pp. 32-48), e.g. saving uptake 0.263 (0.0761) in Table 6 (p. 34) against the 0.260 difference here. The text cites Table A4 as a difference in means and then points to the regression (p. 33).

not_stored.reason: plain endline difference in means; the paper gives regression estimates of the same outcomes in Tables 5-18, so this column is not stored. It would be stored, labelled 'unadjusted difference in means', only if it were the paper's only estimate for an outcome (Decided by Lucas, 22 Nov 2026)
pooled sample mean, not an effect

rule: A table of treatment and control means with a difference column is not stored when the paper estimates the same outcomes by regression elsewhere. Means and p-values are never stored. The column would be stored, labelled 'unadjusted difference in means', only where it is the paper's only estimate.

resolved_questions.question: RCT follow-up difference in means without regression or controls: should the 'Difference in means (2-3)' column be stored as a programme effect (for example effect_type 'unadjusted difference in means', no SE, with the p-value dropped), or left unstored because the same outcomes have regression estimates in Tables 5-18? If stored, two cells need a decision: 'Number of months needed for drought recovery' prints +1.127 although the means give -1.127 (store as printed, or recomputed from the means?), and 'Drought impact (1/0)' has means above 1, so its label or scale is wrong. The design adds one more doubt: 10 of the 24 control clusters come from another district (Neno), so the comparison is not purely within the randomised Mwanza sample.
resolved_questions.resolution: Decided by Lucas, 22 Nov 2026: not stored when regression estimates of the same outcomes exist; stored, labelled, only if it is the only estimate.
